rules.statement: The jus superficiarium can be created by an informal agreement between the landowner and the person who acquires the right, and once acquired, it can be alienated or transmitted to heirs.
rules.supporting_quote: "Ahamado Natchia's case (supra) was considered (after a re-trial) in a second appeal by Lascelles C.J. and Middleton J. in (1906) 9 N.L. R. 331. They observed that 'an agreement between the landowner and the person who acquires the right' is the foundation of the jus superficiarium"
